spans.s:
रञ्ज् (औ) औरञ्ज् r. 1st cl. (रजति-ते) r. 4th cl. (रज्यति-ते) To dye, to tinge,
to give tint or colour to any thing. r. 1st cl. (रजति) To be attached
to, or intent on, to have one's affections or passions engaged by
and object. With अनु prefixed.
 1. To be fond of or attached to,
(with a loc.)
 2. To redden. With अप and वि, To averse, to dislike.
With उप, 1. To be eclipsed.
 2. To suffer calamity. Caus. (रञ्जयति-ते)
1. To colour, to redden.
 2. To please.
 3. To conciliate. (रजयति)
To hunt deer.

रञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
 1. What incites or affects.
 2. What colours, &c.
m. (-कः)
 1. Colouring, dyeing.
 2. A colorist, a painter.
 3. A dyer.
4. A stimulus, an inciter of affection, &c.
 5. Biliary humour on
which vision depends.
 n. (-कं)
 1.

. The mendhi-plant,
(Lawsonia inermis.)
 E. रञ्ज् to colour, वुन् aff. “भल्लातके, काम्पिल्ल वृक्षे च.”

रञ्जन mn. (-नः-नं)
 1. Colouring, dyeing, painting, &c.
 2. Affecting the
heart, exciting passion, &c.
 n. (-नं) Red Sandal or Sappan wood.
“वकम्काठ”.
 f. (-नी)
 1. The Indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
 2.
Bengal madder.
 3. Another plant, commonly Sundarochani, (a
species of Crinum.) “कमलागुंँडि

” 4. A flower, (Nyctan-
thes tristis.)
 E. रञ्ज् to colour, aff. युच् or ल्युट् ।

रञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Moved or affected.
 2. Coloured, dyed, tinted.
E. रञ्ज् to colour, क्त aff.
